title_zh: 拉萨市启动2026年“社保服务进万家”活动
title_en: Lhasa Launches 2026 'Social Insurance Services for Every Household' Campaign
summary_zh: 拉萨市启动2026年“社保服务进万家”活动，推动社保政策与经办服务下沉基层、走近群众。
summary_en: Lhasa launched its 2026 "Social Insurance Services for Every Household" campaign, aiming to bring social insurance policies and services closer to residents at the grassroots level.
